prompt:
透明背景。Draw ONE complete full-body arcade pixel sprite in the exact WHOLE-BODY POSE from image 1. Image 1 is a guide only. Image 2 is the accepted Ultraman Arc LUNA ARMOR identity, whose exact armor, head, red/silver suit, colors and body proportions must clothe that pose. One complete person, one animation phase, fixed side camera facing SCREEN RIGHT.
Permanent depth identity: WHITE guide chain is the NEAR leg closest to the camera, painted BRIGHT SILVER. DARK GREY guide chain is the FAR leg behind in depth, painted DARK SILVER. These identities stay fixed as the legs swing. Follow each whole hip-to-knee-to-ankle chain in guide 1.
REQUIRED WALK PHASE 06: FAR SUPPORT / NEAR PASSING: Both ankles are directly BELOW THE PELVIS on the SAME vertical x. The DARK FAR leg supports the body, its dark boot FLAT on the ground. The WHITE NEAR leg swings forward UNDER the pelvis with a bent knee and its bright boot RAISED above ground. Feet almost overlap horizontally, but have clear vertical separation. Dark support foot DOWN; bright passing foot UP. This is the opposite support from phase 02.
Walking keeps at least one foot on the ground. Keep modest weight transfer, natural chest/hip coordination and guarded counter-swing of both arms, the same limb lengths, and an upright torso centered over the feet. Make the passing/support difference obvious. All joints connect as a continuous natural suit; character and armor redrawn together as one whole frame.
Preserve image 2's low silver swept head crest and opening, yellow eye, cyan chest lamp, blue moon shoulder and chest armor, round cyan wrist disks, and red-silver continuous suit. Hard limited 32-color pixel clusters, dark stepped outlines and upper-left light. Keep original armor segmentation, remove toy ball joints, screw holes, plastic seams or supports.
True RGBA transparent background. Full head, both feet, both hands and every armor tip inside transparent margins. No background, shadow, text, grids, guide lines, skeleton, extra people, weapons or FX. Do not add Q/charge glow. No limb cutting, mirroring, rotating, swapping or pasted body parts.
